observations: Photo 0 shows an open electrical terminal/control compartment with exposed cabling, corrosion, and visible debris (leaves, dirt) accumulated inside.
Photo 1 shows a rectangular metal housing with a rounded end bell (alternator-style) sitting on wet ground outdoors, surface heavily oxidized and water-stained.

Photo 2 shows the same unit from another angle: a control panel face with many cable glands/knobs, some holes with missing fittings, mounted on what looks like an alternator stator housing with cooling fins.
No engine, radiator, fuel tank, or control panel display is visible in any photo - only what appears to be a generator alternator head/stator assembly.
No manufacturer nameplate, brand logo, or model number is legible in any photo.
Unit is resting directly on wet, muddy ground alongside scrap/tarps, suggesting outdoor storage without weather protection.
Watermark reads 'Jueco Generators' - a marketplace/reseller watermark, not a manufacturer brand.

identity.kind: used industrial generator alternator head / stator assembly

claims.claim: Excellent working condition without any issues
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows corrosion on terminal studs and debris/dirt inside the compartment; photo 1 and 2 show heavy surface oxidation and rust streaks consistent with long outdoor exposure, not excellent condition.

claims.claim: Still in factory condition and never been worked on
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows a control panel with several empty/mismatched glad-hand holes and visible panel damage, and photo 0 shows disturbed wiring and loose debris, inconsistent with an untouched factory state.

risks.risk: Internal winding/stator condition and insulation integrity cannot be assessed from exterior photos.
risks.proof: Clip of unit running under load showing stable voltage/frequency on a meter, or a megger/insulation resistance test reading.

risks.risk: Water ingress or corrosion damage from prolonged outdoor storage on wet ground.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of internal windings and bearing housings, plus a dry-storage history or recent service record.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high risk of corrosion damage, factored into worst case

risks.risk: Missing or non-original components in the control/terminal panel (several holes without fittings in photo 2).
risks.proof: Full inventory photo list of all panel components with close-ups confirming completeness.

risks.risk: No visible engine or prime mover; unclear if this is sold as alternator head only or part of a complete genset.
risks.proof: Wide shot showing the full generator set including engine, or seller confirmation with photo of matching engine serial plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as alternator head only, not complete genset

risks.risk: No brand, kVA rating, or model plate visible, so capacity and market comparables are uncertain.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating/nameplate, usually on the end bell or stator housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced at low end of generic alternator-head range for unknown capacity

proof_requests: Close-up clear photo of any rating/nameplate (kVA, voltage, serial number) on the stator or end bell.
Video of the unit running under load with a meter showing voltage/frequency output.
Wide photo showing whether an engine/prime mover is included or if this is the alternator head alone.
Close-up of the internal windings and bearings to assess corrosion/water damage.
Photos confirming all panel components (missing holes in photo 2) are present and functional.
response.reason: The item is identifiable only by type as a used generator alternator head with no readable brand or model, and visible corrosion, debris, and incomplete panel fittings directly contradict the seller's claims of excellent, factory, untouched condition, so it must be priced at worst case as non-working/incomplete pending proof.
